theorems.statement: ∀ (N m k : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn (m + k)) 1 M → IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → (∀ (V : Set (Rn (m + k))) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → ContinuousOn (coareaJacobian M f) M → ∀ y : Rn m, Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn k) 1 ((M ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}) \ {x | coareaJacobian M f x = 0})
